title: Weekly Repo Activity publish manifest
description: The `_SUCCESS.json` A writes into one week directory of a Weekly Repo Activity snapshot (S15P21E102-225). Its presence means the week is final: every row it names was written and read back before this file existed. C verifies `row_digest` against the data at `data_uri` before consuming. A week whose rows change under the same `dataset_snapshot_id` is not an update — it is a new snapshot id, a new manifest and a new completion event.

dataset_snapshot_id.description: The snapshot this week belongs to. Stable across a re-run that produces identical rows; a different id is the only way to publish different rows for the same week.

week_start.description: The Monday, in UTC, of the week these rows belong to. `AI/trend/archive.py` refuses a WEEK period that does not start on a Monday.

data_uri.description: The week directory holding the Parquet rows. The manifest sits inside it, so `data_uri` is this file's own parent.

row_count.description: Rows in the week directory, counted during the read-back that preceded this manifest.

row_digest.description: Content digest of the rows. Not a byte checksum: Parquet part files carry a random UUID and a `created_by` build string, so two runs of the same job over the same data differ byte-for-byte. `Infra/spark/dataset_digest.py` hashes the ordered schema and the canonical-JSON rows instead, which is what this records.
